Pree is on the Central team, and I don't know who owns Thornbury. If she owns it, I can send her the rate. If she doesn't, Anselm or June has to approve it first. Pree's address (psundaram@pemberline.com) is internal, so Ruth doesn't need to sign off on the mail itself.

I've asked you to send me the rate, or tell me where it's written down, and to tell me who owns Thornbury. If the owner isn't Pree, I'll prepare the draft and ask Anselm or June to approve it. Nothing will be sent until one of them does.
